title: AccessCondition
description: A single comparison predicate that tests one named request-context attribute (subject claim, resource property, environment value) against a literal or referenced value using one operator, and yields a denial message when false. It carries no effect of its own; it is evaluated as one term within a PolicyRule, ResourceOperation or InformationRight authorization check. Use Condition instead when the logic is a reusable, free-form or compound expression (time windows, combined attribute logic) rather than one field-operator-value test. Use PolicyRule instead when the unit carries a permit/deny effect or obligations, not just a boolean test. Use ValidationRule instead when the check enforces format, range or integrity of field data rather than deciding whether a principal may access something. Use InformationRight instead when the element grants named operations on an information entity to a specific actor, even if it embeds a constraint.

field.description: Dot-path name of the request-context attribute being tested (e.g. 'subject.role', 'resource.ownerId', 'env.ipAddress'), as it is resolved at evaluation time.

operator.description: Comparison operator applied to the field value, per XACML 3.0 match function semantics.

value.description: Comparison operand as a string: a literal, a comma-separated list for 'in', a regex for 'matches', or a context reference such as '${subject.id}'. Leave empty only for operator 'exists'.

message.description: Human-readable denial reason returned or logged when the predicate evaluates to false, e.g. 'Caller must belong to the resource tenant'.

source.description: Where the field value is read from in the request context, such as 'token', 'header', 'path', 'query', 'body', 'session' or 'environment'. Set it so evaluators know which input to resolve.

x-dr-standard: NIST SP 800-53 AC-3 (Access Enforcement); XACML 3.0 Match element / NIST SP 800-162 ABAC attribute predicate
x-dr-evidence: A guard clause in a handler or middleware that compares one request attribute to a value and throws or returns 403 with a message, e.g. if (req.user.tenantId !== resource.tenantId) throw new ForbiddenError('Tenant mismatch')
A declarative policy or config entry holding a field/operator/value triple, e.g. { attribute: 'token.scope', op: 'contains', value: 'orders:write' } in a Casbin, OPA input or custom rules file
A route or method annotation that asserts a single claim or attribute, e.g. @PreAuthorize("hasAuthority('SCOPE_read')") or requireClaim('email_verified', true)
